title: Merc walks off a 790 uu roof edge, falls, lands and takes fall damage

spawn.spot: east yard roof, edge 288 uu ahead at yaw 12288 (67.5 degrees); the spot of movement.spy-fall-ledge
spawn.notes: The yard floor z -1141.0 lies 790 uu below the roof z -351.0, but at the merc's walking speed (346.5 uu/s, no slow mode) he flies further than the spy of movement.spy-fall-ledge and lands on a step 18 uu above the yard: the recorded drop (fZMaxFalling - Location.Z at landing) is 772.6 uu (774.9 when the last air frame is already below the step top). Merc fall damage int((h - 450) / 550 * 100).

inputs.note: let go while falling, before landing
